messages:
maya: Quick headcheck — L40 regional sweep results landed. Flashv3 wins for long-context but small-payload latency regresses. Do we want an automatic switchover rule or keep manual?

alex: i'd prefer a signal-based switchover. payload-shape + p50 lookup. if median tokens > 128 -> flashv3, else triton/vendor. simple and explainable. :+1:

ravi: fwiw quantization changes the numbers. Q8 reduces flashv3 advantage on long seqs by ~10% but helps memory. posted a short table below.

ci-bench-bot: benchmark summary (region=us-west2, model=redwood-base-13b-q8):
```
payload<=64 | Triton-vendor: 8200 qps, p95=18ms
payload 256  | Flashv3: 1400 qps, Triton: 980 qps
payload 512  | Flashv3: 1180 qps, Triton: 760 qps
H100 vs L40 diff: L40 flashv3 latency ~+12% small-payload vs H100
```

ravi: also saw microburst warmup effects. flashv3 cold p95 spikes if packing isn't primed. we should bias switchover against very bursty routes unless warmup windows present.

sylvie: agree on hysteresis. proposal: require 3-min sustained signal + 2 consecutive sampling windows before switching. also add revert window of 5m to avoid flip-flopping.

maya: sounds good. we should encode the rule as a per-route policy: metrics include median_payload_tokens, p95_latency_delta, recent_burst_index. if p95_delta < -10% and median_tokens>128 -> prefer flashv3. if small payload and triton p95 < flashv3 p95 by >8% -> prefer triton.

darren: can we add a cheap classifier in the router to pick kernel by payload size percentile? that'll be <1ms overhead. we can fallback to model-variant routing if kernel fails.

alex: implementation notes:
- add route config knobs: min_samples, min_duration, hysteresis_backoff
- emit debug tags so perf dashboard can show which kernel was picked and why
- record quantization mode (Q4/Q8) since that changes thresholds

ci-bench-bot: follow-up artifact: perf diffs pushed to /bench/ci/2398765432, contains payload histograms + regional breakdown.

maya: action items:
- eng-ml: add router classifier + telemetry (darren + alex)
- bench: run Q4/Q8 sweep across H100/L40/A100 (ravi)
- observability: surface kernel decision reason on console (sylvie)

sylvie: will add dashboard card and an anomaly alert if kernel flip rate > 0.5 per min.

maya: sweet — let's aim to ship the classifier + dashboard by next sprint. if bench shows notable quant sensitivity we'll gate rollout behind Q-sweep. :seedling:
